caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects placed on a blank, light-colored background. The object in the upper center is a roughly cylindrical wooden mortar with a wider base and a slightly narrower opening at the top, standing upright. The wood is various shades of brown, with visible grain lines, cracks, and surface texture indicating age and use. Below the mortar, horizontally aligned and slightly to the left, is a wooden pestle that is fairly straight with a darker end and a ring-like element near one end, also showing wood grain and a worn appearance. Both objects are rendered in realistic detail, showing natural wood colors and texture. The overall composition is centered within a subtle rectangular outline.
title: Pestle and Mortar
